theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cttp_bti_blowup_translate_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (lam t : ℝ), 0 < lam → 0 < 1 + lam * t → (∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ ((fun x => c • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ n) * μ A) → (∀ B : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet B → ν B = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * μ (dilation p lam ⁻¹' B)) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → ∫ y, f (y - t • p) ∂ν = (1 + lam * t) ^ n * ∫ y, f ((1 + lam * t) • y) ∂ν
